Generate a single PDF from all coaching playbooks using ReportLab, converting markdown text, tables, and inline formatting into ReportLab flowables with a cover page.

Builds a single versatile PowerPoint template (.potx) by extracting 20 chosen layouts from a source .potx, renumbering them, and stripping slides, notes, tags, and redundant layouts.

Scans every .pptx file in a directory and reports a per-file layout inventory table (file, slide size, master/layout counts, layout type counts) plus a canonical-coverage score ranking which file's layouts best cover the 14 layout purposes a versatile master needs.

A command-line tool for querying, comparing, and managing the ACME certificate reconciliation process, including viewing elements and flows, searching, showing fixes and next steps, syncing from poster HTML, and exporting the poster to PDF, SVG, BPMN, VSDX, draw.io, or Mermaid formats.

Seeds Wikipedia article URLs as depth_hint=2 sources for L2 verbatim content and lowers WEF report URLs from depth_hint=3 to 2 in the syllabus database.
Generates LLM content for syllabus topics, repairing malformed JSON emitted by the model (orphan strings, trailing commas, missing braces, unescaped control characters) before parsing.

Seeds a SQLite database with German-locale Microsoft Learn module URLs for the copilot-m365 topic and support.microsoft.com per-app Copilot URLs for six per-app topics, inserting source_url and routing_rule rows idempotently.
Seeds university and German-language sources (German Wikipedia, German AI portals, and university pages) into the provider registry for L3 DE and L4 EN/DE verbatim content.
Generates role-differentiated syllabus content for a given topic and role (or all roles), targeting roles missing akademisch or einfach content variants.
Generate weekly Provider Intelligence Briefs as PDF files with JSON sidecar files for a specified provider or all providers, optionally for a given ISO week and year.
Populate the topic_embedding table for all active topics using nomic-embed-text via Ollama, with an option to re-embed topics that already have embeddings.

Seeds depth_hint=4 source records for L4 verbatim gaps by bumping existing vendor doc URLs from depth 3 to 4 and inserting new MS Learn URLs as pending crawls, then prints the resulting depth_hint distribution.
Seeds topic_role_rel rows for the 6 Copilot app sub-topics, idempotently inserting role scores sourced from Microsoft adoption guides, and returns a dict of rows inserted per app slug.
Generates L2–L5 long-form documents for syllabus topics using a verbatim-first strategy, with options to filter by slug, process only topics with verbatim source chunks, and enable debug logging.
Generate a weekly freshness PDF report from provider_changelog data in a SQLite database for a given ISO week (defaulting to the current week), writing the PDF to an output directory.

Seeds the copilot-m365 topic and its job-title relevance scores into the SQLite database, intended to be run once after initial DB setup and idempotent via INSERT OR IGNORE / ON CONFLICT.

Scores the relevance of AI topics for different job roles by calling an LLM and storing the results in a database.
Renders a Reifegrad maturity matrix as a self-contained HTML file from a JSON descriptor, with optional timeline and scrollytelling story modes.

Seeds MS Learn unit-level URLs into the syllabus database for depth_hint=4 sources, since module overview pages yield no chunks, with options to select a list (e.g. azure or copilot) and run in dry-run mode.

Streamlit UI for MeetingProcessor that loads and validates config, builds enabled format and delivery exporters, and provides tabs to process meetings, view usage stats, adjust settings (admin only), and run demos.

Read-only, idempotent import of v1 data into v2, opening v1 in read-only mode and placing topics into matching v2 topic groups by slug or into the `v1-legacy-holding` group.

A CLI for the Lecture2Skill pipeline that acquires lecture transcripts, extracts schemas, compiles them into skill .md files, and manages deployment, promotion, run status, and queue processing.

A command-line tool for video production workflows that analyzes reference videos for replication, lists analyzed videos, runs Kaizen retrospectives on produced videos, and shows accumulated video production patterns.

FLM Typer CLI for a freelance lead pipeline, with commands to show pipeline status, review leads by tier, run processing and LLM scoring, delete or archive leads, sync skill aliases, and authorize Gmail OAuth (optionally with a --code argument).

Configures CLI runtime behavior for token-efficient output, including global flags, logging levels, a shared Rich console, and patched echo functions to enforce output limits.

Run, list, show, export, fire, poll, and wait on topic-research dossiers, including probing search/fetch legs and checking how well a dossier's synthesis is grounded in its cited sources.

Manage a UX consulting corpus: sync design docs into storage and a QMD index, discover and ingest UX guideline pages, list docs, show a stored DESIGN.md, and search UX docs via QMD.

A CLI command that extracts voice insights for a given topic by fetching posts from a source (default Reddit), with options for mock data, a max item limit per subreddit, and table or JSON output.

A Typer CLI for Process Discovery that lists, shows, and exports process models and signals, and ingests transcripts to extract process models via an LLM.

Browser-driven extraction of the Google I/O '26 speaker roster from io.google into a quarantine directory, with robots.txt/ToS pre-flight, custom user agent, shadow-DOM traversal, and SHA-256-stamped audit logging.

Builds graph-4 database rows (network_graph, filtered Google/DeepMind/Alphabet speakers, and PlatformIdentity records) from a graph4 quarantine extraction, with options to select a quarantine ID and preview inserts via dry-run.
